items.analysis: LocalCompact uses the native compact-open C(X,Y) and the ordinary product. Only X is locally compact; there is no additional local compactness premise on Z. I also read the fixed mathlib ContinuousEval proof: it explicitly takes a compact neighborhood K whose image is in the given open set, then uses [K,O] times that neighborhood. ContinuousMap.curry is continuous without a local-compactness premise on the parameter, while uncurry uses local compactness only on the input X. The actual inverse formulas and parameter/input/output naturality are proved pointwise. No outer mapping-space Homeomorph requiring extra local compactness is substituted for the requested bijection.

The cover is the actual same-universe Ultrafilter S profinite space, with continuous extension of id and surjectivity witnessed by principal ultrafilters; the resulting compact-to-Hausdorff quotient map yields both continuous-map and open-set detection. Kify is the actual compactlyGenerated topology built from all small CompHaus probes, not an assumed equivalent topology. Every natural transformation is recovered by point evaluation and proved continuous by the quotient-cover probe test; map_to_probe is its proved inverse. OriginalFull quantifies over every original-universe Hausdorff target and every natural transformation. Necessity genuinely applies it to kX and the actual probe identity, yielding continuity of the underlying identity X -> kX; sufficiency uses the compactly generated source property. No pointwise argument is used without the continuity bridge.

The carrier is exactly C(kX,kY), with compact-open topology followed by the actual kification. continuous_kcurry_co uses compact Hausdorff probes and compact subsets of kX, and continuous_kuncurry uses evaluation after restricting along a compact probe; neither assumes original X locally compact. kify_product_homeo explicitly distinguishes the ordinary product and the k product. Realization represents every profinite parameter, with the proved restriction naturality, and evaluation_induces_equiv identifies the actual evaluation operation with the full all-Hausdorff-parameter equivalence. Pre/postcomposition maps are continuous and their naturality, identities and composition formulas are verified. MappingUniverse gives bijections for all ambient-universe natural transformations, the natural representation iso, actual carrier/record smallness and empty-source/empty-target cases. General uniqueness is correctly only after kification.

The general first-countability result uses mathlib first-countable -> sequential -> small-universe compactly generated; I read the sequential-instance proof, which uses ULift of the genuine one-point compactification of N as the compact sequence probe. The negative evaluation example uses actual standard Q and R, the native compact-open topology and ordinary product. A compact neighborhood in Q would give local compactness and hence completeness of its topological additive group, contradicting the dense rational embedding and sqrt(2). The evaluation proof merges finitely many genuine compact-open constraints into K, chooses a in the given rational neighborhood outside K, and uses Urysohn separation to construct an actual continuous g zero on K and equal to 2 at a. This refutes continuity at (zero map,0), not merely at an unspecified point or only non-local-compactness.

Fortissimo is the actual Option D space with isolated finite points and cocountable neighborhoods at none. Its topology axioms, Hausdorff separation, non-openness of the infinity singleton and finiteness of all compact subsets are proved. The actual kification is proved discrete by finite images of all compact probes, and the underlying inverse identity is not continuous. The concrete D=Set N has uncountability proved by Cantor diagonalization. fortissimo_counterexample uses the specified continuous underlying identity kX -> X, proves its actual probe_post is an isomorphism, and excludes every Homeomorph having exactly that forward function; it does not merely compare arbitrary homeomorphism types.

JointComposition constructs an actual continuous map on k(M(Y,Z) times M(X,Y)). Its uncurried version varies g,f,x simultaneously: k projections/pairing feed two proved k evaluations, then the proved exponentiation yields the joint composition map. The application formula is genuine function composition, and associativity and both identities hold for every actual map by function extensionality. isIso_iff_khomeomorph is the exact condition on the specified f: the witness homeomorphism must agree pointwise with kmap f; an unrelated homeomorphism of kX/kY is not enough. Its reverse builds the actual probe isomorphism and identifies its forward map with probe_post f. For first-countable X/Y, firstCountableHomeomorph composes the actual kification homeomorphisms with this probe homeomorphism, and its proved value is the original f. All additional Hausdorff assumptions required by the task hold; general theorems sometimes require fewer, never more.
